summary: Iteration 113 - Tested new Day-by-Day Timeline (1-40) feature for 40-day courses. Found and FIXED critical localStorage persistence bug. All features now working: checkbox toggles, journal notes, progress bar, locked days for non-purchased users, and data persistence across modal close/reopen.

VERIFIED: Day-by-Day Timeline (1-40) component displays correctly in Journey tab for all 3 courses
VERIFIED: Per-day checkbox toggles work correctly (Day 1, Day 2 tested)
VERIFIED: Per-day journal notes input works and persists after modal close/reopen
VERIFIED: Progress count (X/40 complete) updates correctly when checkboxes are toggled
VERIFIED: Progress bar updates correctly with visual feedback
VERIFIED: Locked behavior works for non-purchased users - Days beyond first phase are disabled with lock icon and 'Unlock full course to journal this day' placeholder
VERIFIED: Days 21-40 are visible in the timeline for all courses
VERIFIED: No regression in existing journey phase chips and phase content blocks
VERIFIED: No regression in course modal open/close/tab switching (all 7 tabs work)

success_rate.backend: 100% (API /api/courses returns correct data for all 3 courses)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Day-by-Day Timeline features working, persistence fixed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 113 tested and fixed the new Day-by-Day Timeline feature. The localStorage persistence bug was fixed by using useEffect to load data when courseId changes, and saving data synchronously in the toggle/update callbacks. All 3 courses (13th Rite of Womb, Nusta Karpay, Munay Ki) now have working day-by-day tracking with checkboxes, notes, and progress bar. Data persists across modal close/reopen.

bug_fix_details.issue: localStorage persistence not working - data lost after modal close/reopen
bug_fix_details.root_cause: Race condition between two useEffect hooks - save effect ran with initial empty state before load effect completed, overwriting stored data
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: 1) Initialize state with empty object, 2) Load from localStorage in useEffect when courseId changes, 3) Save synchronously in toggleDay and updateNote callbacks using saveProgress helper
bug_fix_details.verification: Tested checkbox toggle, note input, modal close/reopen - all data persists correctly
